derivation.rule: Choose authority multiplier so the worst per-seed fifth percentile saturation scale reaches approximately 0.95; this covers 95% of active events without sizing to the single worst instant.
derivation.assessment: The percentile prediction held for seeds 30000, 30007, and 30013, but not 30048; the changed trajectory and remaining severe tail left only 88.3% of its formerly active timesteps at scale >=0.95.

physical_plausibility.finding: Within documented commercial pod-drive thrust, though aggressive for this research USV.
physical_plausibility.comparison: Torqeedo Cruise 6.0 FP lists 230 lbf static thrust (approximately 1023 N), close to the selected 1000 N per pod.
physical_plausibility.limitation: The comparison establishes thrust-scale plausibility, not a complete mass, power, endurance, packaging, or maneuvering validation for Vehicle C.
